Market today: Mixed signals. Alibaba's cloud growth is a tech positive, but rising bond yields are a real driver that could weigh on your growth-heavy tech/chip names. Geopolitical tensions add uncertainty.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.56%) and SPAL (-40%) are deep in the red. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay and drops are amplified, especially with your margin use. SMH (-11.86%) and QQQI (-3.67%) also need attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields for their impact on tech valuations. Also, monitor geopolitical developments for broader market sentiment shifts.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions tightly and stay vigilant on macro risks.
plays: SOXL is down -52.56% and leveraged. Re-evaluate your 200 stop or trim to cut margin risk.
SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is down -40%. Its default stop is 21.38; manage this volatile position closely.
Consider MSFT for accumulation given positive cloud sentiment. Scanner entry 483.59-483.11, stop 482.15.
